title: External products respect Segal and coefficient equivalences
statement: Use the Segal-presheaf notation and the fixed-endpoint coefficient localization of [def-coef-segal-presheaf-localization]. Let $C,D$ be small monoidal infinity categories. If $f:X\to X'$ is a Segal equivalence in $P(C_\otimes)$ and $Y\in P(D_\otimes)$ is any presheaf, then $f\boxtimes\mathrm{id}_Y$ is a Segal equivalence in $P((C\times D)_\otimes)$; the analogous assertion holds with the variables interchanged. If $X\in Q_C$ and $Y\in Q_D$, then $X\boxtimes Y\in Q_{C\times D}$. For monoidally compatible small sets $S\subset\operatorname{Ar}(P(C))$, $T\subset\operatorname{Ar}(P(D))$, if $f:X\to X'$ is an $S$-local Segal equivalence between Segal presheaves and $Y\in Q_D$, then $f\boxtimes\mathrm{id}_Y$ is an $S\odot T$-local Segal equivalence. If $X\in Q_C$ and $g:Y\to Y'$ is a $T$-local Segal equivalence, then $\mathrm{id}_X\boxtimes g$ is an $S\odot T$-local Segal equivalence.
